svg.title: Received cash and invoice allocation
svg.desc: Received cash and invoice allocation. Why can received cash and an open invoice coexist? Primary tables: CashReceipt, CashReceiptApplication. Receipt and invoice dates do not establish allocation. CashReceiptApplication supplies the amount and application date; CashReceipt.SalesInvoiceID is compatibility metadata.
